script: Deep beneath Westminster Abbey, a 150-year-old mystery just cracked wide open. For generations, a peculiar Roman coffin lay hidden, its occupant unknown. But now, cutting-edge forensic analysis has finally peered inside, revealing astonishing details about the individual. Scientists believe they've identified a wealthy Roman woman, potentially linked to the very first Roman settlement of London. Her story, after all these years, is finally being told.
